criteria.requirement: Add liquid.context_schema.ContextField(path tuple[str|int],expected_type,required=True,nullable=False), ContextSchema and validate_context(data,schema). Read declared Mapping/list/tuple paths only; report all missing and wrong-type fields in declaration order without values. Support explicit list indices, optional missing and nullable None separately; bool cannot satisfy int. Do not render templates, invoke filters or arbitrary object getters, infer filter types or declare dynamic paths complete. Schema copies field declarations, rejects duplicate/invalid paths, and extra undeclared data remains allowed. Default rendering behavior stays unchanged.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
